subject: "mnormt" package dependency / downward compatibility of GenomicSEM

messages.author: a01a26b6ad3d73df
messages.subject: "mnormt" package dependency / downward compatibility of GenomicSEM
parts:
Dear Genomic SEM Team,

I am restricted to use an R version < 4.0.0, though the newest GenomicSEM / lavaan release "requires" the most recent "mnormt" package, which in turn requires R version >= 4.0.0. Due to this dependency the GenomicSEM / lavaan package cannot be installed. I guess a solution could be to install an older mnormt package, though I am not certain that this is compatible with the requirements of both the GenomicSEM as well as the lavaan packages. 

Could you provide advice how to solve or circumvent this issue, and comment on potential dependencies between mnormt, lavaan and GenomicSEM versions?

Thank you,
Ulrich

messages.author: 3cd246d2b547f564
messages.subject: Re: "mnormt" package dependency / downward compatibility of GenomicSEM
parts:
Hi Ulrich

You should be able to install an older version of mnormt from the CRAN archive to get around this version dependency:

install.packages('https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/mnormt/mnormt_1.5-7.tar.gz')



Best

Mark

messages.subject: Re: "mnormt" package dependency / downward compatibility of GenomicSEM
parts:
Hi Mark,

super, thank you for the quick reply. I used: 

"require(devtools)
install_version("mnormt", version = "1.5-7", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")"

and it worked fine as well, and so did the subsequent lavaan and GenomicSEM installations on R version 3.6.3. Seems all fine then for the moment.

Best, Ulrich
